name: Access Scope Finding Destination
description: The destination role of the Network Access Analyzer compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): a finding, the middle node -> the last component of its path, in SequenceNumber order: the resource the path reaches. The targets are the types the Network Access Analyzer guide says a finding's path can start or end at. The finding retires with this end (COMPOUND_EDGE retires_with). Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/network_insights.py (aws-core-tap#212, #248).
